headline.title: Our new community investments in Virginia support local jobs and expand energy affordability.
headline.summary: The article outlines new community investments in Virginia aimed at supporting local job creation and enhancing energy affordability. These initiatives focus on developing the state's workforce and funding energy programs to benefit residents.

articles.title: SpaceX officially prices shares at $135 in the largest IPO ever
articles.summary: SpaceX has officially priced its shares at $135 as it launches the largest initial public offering (IPO) in history. The IPO marks a significant milestone for the company as it begins trading on the stock market.

articles.title: Amazon’s data centers used 2.5 billion gallons of water last year
articles.summary: Amazon disclosed that its data centers consumed 2.5 billion gallons of water last year, marking the first time the company has shared such data. This announcement comes shortly after Seattle implemented a one-year moratorium on new data centers, amid growing concerns over water and energy usage in AI data center construction.

articles.title: SpaceX SPV investors won’t know their true holdings until post-IPO lock-ups lift
articles.summary: SpaceX's SPV investors will remain unaware of their actual holdings until the post-IPO lock-up period concludes, facing potential hidden fees and extended payout delays. Additionally, these investors are at risk of fraud, complicating their financial outcomes following the company's public offering.

articles.title: Deezer’s new tool can identify AI music from Spotify, Apple Music, and others
articles.summary: Deezer has launched a new tool that scans playlists from Spotify, Apple Music, and other music platforms to identify tracks created by artificial intelligence. This feature aims to enhance user awareness and understanding of AI-generated music in their playlists.

articles.title: Pool’s new app turns your screenshots into something useful
articles.summary: Pool has launched a new app that organizes screenshots into personalized collections and retrieves original links for saved content. The app aims to help users rediscover products, recipes, travel ideas, and other items they intended to revisit.

articles.title: DoorDash’s new AI chatbot lets you order with prompts and photos
articles.summary: DoorDash has introduced a new AI chatbot named Ask DoorDash, enabling users to place orders using natural language prompts and photos. This feature aims to streamline the ordering process by allowing customers to search for items without manually scrolling through the app.

articles.title: Grok Is Still Hosting Sexualized Deepfakes of Famous Women
articles.summary: A WIRED investigation revealed that Grok's website hosts numerous sexualized deepfake images and videos of famous women, including nonconsensual depictions of celebrities and a prominent US politician. The findings raise significant concerns about privacy and consent in the realm of deepfake technology.

articles.title: Google DeepMind is worried about what happens when millions of agents start to interact
articles.summary: Google DeepMind is investing in research to explore the risks associated with the interaction of millions of AI agents online. Rohin Shah, the director of AGI safety and alignment research at the company, highlights concerns about the implications of these agents operating autonomously and following instructions from one another.

articles.title: Save Big and Play Bigger: GeForce NOW Summer Sale Brings Major Membership Savings
articles.summary: The GeForce NOW summer sale has launched, offering discounts of up to $70 on 12-month memberships for a limited time. This promotion aims to encourage PC gamers to upgrade their cloud gaming experience.

articles.title: Supporting Europe’s work in ensuring a trustworthy AI ecosystem
articles.summary: OpenAI has expressed its support for the EU Code of Practice on AI content transparency, focusing on the development of provenance standards and tools. These efforts aim to enhance public understanding of AI-generated content within Europe.

articles.title: Anthropic apologizes for invisible Claude Fable guardrails
articles.summary: Anthropic has issued an apology for implementing hidden guardrails in its AI model, Claude Fable 5, which affected both researchers and competitors. The company plans to increase transparency regarding the activation of these restrictions, even if it results in the model declining more queries.
